note: Objects a world gets without a file: creatures built by kind (scene.creatures) and the town's procedural buildings (iamar-world assets building). Read from the iamar browser source (not public) 98c2ecd2 (creatures; was 79512407): scripts/worlds/asset_library.gd CREATURES and scripts/kit/kit_buildings.gd KINDS. Triangles are null until measured (C2/C3).

creatures.name: cow
creatures.description: A dairy cow: wanders slowly within its radius and grazes when idle.

creatures.name: horse
creatures.description: A horse: wanders within its radius and grazes when idle (not rideable in a package world).

creatures.name: chicken
creatures.description: A hen: wanders within its radius and pecks when idle. A small farm animal and a bird.

creatures.name: bunny
creatures.description: A rabbit: hops about within its radius and nibbles when idle.

creatures.name: deer
creatures.description: A red deer: wanders within its radius and grazes when idle; every second one is a buck with antlers. Flees from the player.
creatures.placement: At a forest edge or meadow with room to run: they flee up to 1.5x the wander_radius (at least radius + 8 m) from home.

creatures.name: wolf
creatures.description: A grey wolf: prowls within its radius and sniffs the ground when idle. Flees from the player (not hostile in a package world).
creatures.placement: In a forest or on a hillside with room to run: they flee up to 1.5x the wander_radius (at least radius + 8 m) from home.

creatures.name: duck
creatures.description: Mallards, drakes and hens in turn: float on the water at the entry's height, paddle about within the radius and dabble when idle.
creatures.placement: On a pond or river: set position y to the water surface and keep the wander_radius inside the water.

creatures.name: duckling
creatures.description: A mallard duckling: floats on the water at the entry's height and paddles about within the radius.
creatures.placement: On a pond or river: set position y to the water surface and keep the wander_radius inside the water.

creatures.name: fish
creatures.description: A pond fish: swims just below the water surface (the entry's height) within the radius, tail beating.
creatures.placement: On a pond or river: set position y to the water surface and keep the wander_radius inside the water.

creatures.name: frog
creatures.description: A green frog: hops about within its radius.
creatures.placement: At a pond edge or in damp grass.

creatures.name: turtle
creatures.description: A pond turtle: crawls slowly within its radius.
creatures.placement: At a pond edge, on mud or flat stones.

creature_cite: the iamar browser source (not public) 98c2ecd2 scripts/worlds/asset_library.gd CREATURES, scripts/worlds/world_creatures.gd (deer and wolves flee from the player; ducks float on and fish swim just below the water at the entry's y; no petting, riding or combat in package worlds)

generators.name: town house
generators.description: Oakhaven's procedural town house with open doorways and a furnished, walkable interior; width, depth, floors and wall style (plaster, stone, brick) are parameters. Or plan a house from its rooms: iamar-world assets building house <out.glb> --rooms bedroom:3,living,kitchen,bath:2 [--floors 1|2] [--style beach|modern|plaster|stone] [--roof gable|flat].
